title: PBVS 2026 - Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution (HISR) challenge
description:
This challenge benchmarks ×4 super-resolution for close-range SWIR hyperspectral imaging.
Participants receive low-resolution HSI cubes acquired using the same sensor with different lenses to create controlled resolution variation without spectral bias. The task is to reconstruct a high-resolution SWIR hyperspectral image from a ×4 downsampled input.
description_zh:
该竞赛对近距离短波红外高光谱成像的×4超分辨率进行基准测试。
参赛者将获得使用同一传感器和不同镜头采集的低分辨率HSI立方体数据，通过控制分辨率变化而不引入光谱偏差。任务是从×4下采样输入重建高分辨率短波红外高光谱图像。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# PBVS @ CVPR 2026 - Hyperspectral Images Super-Resolution (HISR) challenge

## Overview

Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution (HISR) goes beyond conventional SR: hyperspectral data contain rich wavelength-dependent information, where each band encodes material-specific spectral signatures. This means HISR must simultaneously preserve spatial detail and spectral integrity, ensuring reconstructed images remain physically meaningful rather than visually plausible only.

HSI data are also large and acquisition-intensive, making full-resolution capture costly and slow. Super-resolution therefore offers a powerful and practical pathway to reduce acquisition burden while enabling high-quality analysis.

This challenge introduces the **first** hyperspectral super-resolution benchmark within the PBVS CVPR 2026 workshop. It focuses on real LR-HR pairs, at ×4 SR under controlled lab conditions, using data collected with the same sensor and different optics to isolate spatial scaling while maintaining spectral consistency. 

**The challenge is to reconstruct ×4 real super-resolution hyperspectral images from the provided low-resolution hyperspectral patches image.**

Each low-resolution cube has a perfectly aligned high-resolution counterpart that serves as ground truth, enabling precise evaluation of both spatial recovery and spectral fidelity.
Participants develop methods that upscale the LR data by x4 while preserving spectral consistency across all wavelengths.


## Important dates

- 2026.01.12 Release of train and validation dataset (input and output)
- **2026.01.15 Test data release (inputs only)**
- 2026.01.15 Testing phase server online

- **2026.03.01 Test output results submission deadline**
- 2026.03.03 Contribution from participants (top results should provide a brief description of the proposed solution together with an illustration of the architecture; code also should be shared)
- **2026.03.06 Paper submission deadline for entries from the challenge**
- 2026.06.03 PBVS workshop and challenges, results and award ceremony (CVPR 2026)
pages.content_zh:
# PBVS @ CVPR 2026 - 高光谱图像超分辨率（HISR）挑战赛

## 概述

高光谱图像超分辨率（HISR）超越了传统超分辨率的范畴：高光谱数据包含丰富的波长相关信息，每个波段编码特定材料的光谱特征。这意味着HISR必须同时保持空间细节和光谱完整性，确保重建的图像在物理意义上仍然有效，而不仅仅是视觉上可信。

高光谱图像数据量大且获取成本高，全分辨率采集成本昂贵且耗时。因此，超分辨率提供了一条强大而实用的途径来降低采集负担，同时实现高质量的分析。

本挑战赛引入了**首个**PBVS CVPR 2026研讨会内的高光谱超分辨率基准。它专注于真实的低分辨率-高分辨率配对数据，采用×4超分辨率，在受控的实验室条件下进行，使用同一传感器和不同光学系统采集的数据，以隔离空间缩放并维持光谱一致性。

**本挑战赛的目标是从提供的低分辨率高光谱图像块重建×4实超分辨率高光谱图像。**

每个低分辨率立方体都有一个完美对齐的高分辨率对应物作为真值标签，这使得能够精确评估空间恢复和光谱保真度。

参与者需要开发方法，将低分辨率数据上采样4倍，同时保持所有波长间的光谱一致性。


## 重要日期

- 2026.01.12 训练和验证数据集发布（输入和输出）
- **2026.01.15 测试数据发布（仅输入）**
- 2026.01.15 测试阶段服务器上线

- **2026.03.01 测试结果提交截止日期**
- 2026.03.03 来自参与者的贡献（排名靠前的结果应提供建议方案的简要说明和架构图示；还应共享代码）
- **2026.03.06 挑战赛参赛作品论文提交截止日期**
- 2026.06.03 PBVS研讨会和挑战赛、结果及颁奖仪式（CVPR 2026）

pages.title: Dataset
pages.content:
# Dataset

## Description
The dataset used in this challenge is **Version 2 of the HSI Lens Dataset**, introduced in the PBVS CVPR 2025 paper:  
[Ulrichsen et al., *“A True Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution Dataset”](
https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025W/PBVS/html/Ulrichsen_A_True_Hyperspectral_Image_Super-Resolution_Dataset_CVPRW_2025_paper.html)

This dataset provides **perfectly aligned low- and high-resolution SWIR hyperspectral image pairs**, acquired using a single Specim FX17 line-scanning camera (900–1700 nm). Spatial resolution differences were generated purely through **lens swapping**, ensuring identical spectral content while isolating spatial resolution as the primary challenge.

- High-resolution images: **3172 × 640 px**, captured with a 12° lens  
- Low-resolution images: **793 × 160 px**, captured with a 38° lens  
- Focus ensured using automated focus metrics and verified with sub-pixel registration  

Scenes cover **spectrally rich and diverse SWIR materials**, including plastics, wood, electronics, metals, fabrics, corrosion, printed text, painted surfaces, and various industrial objects.

## Splits
The dataset includes **70 registered image pairs**, divided as follows:
- **55** pairs for training  
- **10** pairs for validation  
- **5** pairs reserved for testing (not released)

Participants receive LR–HR pairs for training and validation.  
For the **test set**, only LR inputs are provided; high-resolution ground truth remains withheld for fair evaluation.
The LR version of the test set patches can be downloaded here: https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=237989c4-8c1a-4bd8-b652-49e5dbd90778

## Availability
The dataset can be downloaded from the repository “Files” section or via:  
**Zenodo DOI:** https://zenodo.org/records/18171738

# 数据集

## 描述
本挑战使用的数据集是 **HSI Lens 数据集第 2 版**，来自 PBVS CVPR 2025 论文：  
[Ulrichsen et al., *"A True Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution Dataset"](
https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025W/PBVS/html/Ulrichsen_A_True_Hyperspectral_Image_Super-Resolution_Dataset_CVPRW_2025_paper.html)

该数据集提供**完美对齐的低分辨率和高分辨率 SWIR 高光谱图像对**，使用单个 Specim FX17 线扫描相机（900–1700 nm）采集。空间分辨率差异完全通过**镜头更换**生成，确保光谱内容相同，同时将空间分辨率作为主要挑战隔离出来。

- 高分辨率图像：**3172 × 640 像素**，使用 12° 镜头拍摄  
- 低分辨率图像：**793 × 160 像素**，使用 38° 镜头拍摄  
- 焦点通过自动焦点指标确保并通过亚像素配准验证  

场景涵盖**光谱丰富且多样的 SWIR 材料**，包括塑料、木材、电子产品、金属、织物、腐蚀、印刷文本、彩绘表面和各种工业物体。

## 数据集划分
数据集包括 **70 个配准图像对**，具体划分如下：
- **55** 对用于训练  
- **10** 对用于验证  
- **5** 对保留用于测试（未发布）

参赛者获得用于训练和验证的 LR–HR 对。  
对于**测试集**，仅提供 LR 输入；高分辨率真值保留以确保公平评估。
测试集补丁的 LR 版本可在此处下载：https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=********-****-****-****-************

## 可用性
数据集可从存储库"文件"部分下载，或通过以下链接获取：  
**Zenodo DOI：** https://zenodo.org/records/18171738

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
# Evaluation Metrics

Submissions are evaluated using **Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR)** and **Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM)**, computed on 20 random patches with a size of **200x200x224 (w x h x bands)** of the hidden hyperspectral test set. Rankings are based on the combined performance across these metrics.

The LR patches of the test dataset can be downloaded here: https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=237989c4-8c1a-4bd8-b652-49e5dbd90778

Both metrics are computed **per band and averaged** over the hyperspectral cube. 

## Evaluation Dataset
Evaluation is performed only on a fixed set of patches, not on the full images.

* **5 test scenes** are selected.
* From each scene, **6 patches are extracted.**
* Each patch has dimensions** 200 × 200 × 224** (height × width × spectral bands).

This results in a total of 30 evaluation patches (5 scenes × 6 patches).
**All metrics are computed exclusively on these 30 patches.**
Full-resolution test images are not used for evaluation.

## Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR)
PSNR measures the pixel-wise reconstruction fidelity between the super-resolved output and the high-resolution ground truth.  
Higher PSNR values indicate more accurate spatial reconstruction.


## Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM)
SAM quantifies the **spectral similarity** between reconstructed and ground-truth spectra at each pixel by measuring the angle between their spectral vectors.  
Lower SAM values indicate better preservation of material-relevant spectral signatures and higher physical plausibility.

Only low-resolution inputs are provided for the test phase; corresponding HR ground truth remains hidden and is used exclusively for evaluation.

## Reproducibility and code availability (mandatory)

To ensure transparency, fairness, and reproducibility, all participating teams are required to make their full source code publicly available, preferably via a GitHub repository.

The released code must include all components necessary to reproduce the reported results, including:
- Training and evaluation scripts
- Model architectures and configuration files
- Dataset loading and preprocessing steps
- Environment specifications (e.g., requirements.txt, environment.yml, or Docker files)
- Clear, step-by-step instructions to run the code end to end

**The challenge organizers will independently train and evaluate all submitted methods from scratch to verify the reported results.
This verification process will directly affect the final ranking.**

**Teams that fail to provide their source code**, or that do not include sufficient information to reproduce their results, **will be disqualified** from the challenge.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估指标

提交的方案使用**峰值信噪比（PSNR）**和**光谱角制图仪（SAM）**进行评估，计算基于隐藏高光谱测试集中20个随机补丁，每个补丁大小为**200x200x224（宽x高x波段）**。排名基于这些指标的综合性能。

测试数据集的LR补丁可从以下地址下载：https://filesender.belnet.be/?s=download&token=********-****-****-****-************

两个指标均**逐波段计算，然后在高光谱立方体上取平均**。

## 评估数据集
评估仅在固定的补丁集上进行，不在完整图像上进行。

* **选择5个测试场景**
* 从每个场景中**提取6个补丁**
* 每个补丁的尺寸为**200 × 200 × 224**（高 × 宽 × 光谱波段）

共产生30个评估补丁（5个场景 × 6个补丁）。
**所有指标仅在这30个补丁上计算**。
完整分辨率测试图像不用于评估。

## 峰值信噪比（PSNR）
PSNR衡量超分辨率输出与高分辨率真实值之间的像素级重建保真度。
更高的PSNR值表示空间重建更准确。

## 光谱角制图仪（SAM）
SAM通过测量每个像素处重建光谱与真实光谱向量之间的角度，量化**光谱相似性**。
更低的SAM值表示对材料相关光谱特征的保留更好，物理可行性更高。

测试阶段仅提供低分辨率输入；对应的HR真实值保持隐藏，仅用于评估。

## 可重现性和代码可用性（强制性）

为确保透明度、公平性和可重现性，所有参赛队伍必须将完整源代码公开发布，最好通过GitHub存储库。

发布的代码必须包含重现报告结果所需的所有组件，包括：
- 训练和评估脚本
- 模型架构和配置文件
- 数据集加载和预处理步骤
- 环境规范（例如requirements.txt、environment.yml或Docker文件）
- 明确的端到端分步说明

**挑战赛组织者将从头独立训练和评估所有提交的方法，以验证报告的结果。
此验证过程将直接影响最终排名**。

**未能提供源代码的团队**，或未包含足够信息来重现其结果的团队，**将被取消资格**。

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
# Submission format

Participants must submit their predictions according to the instructions provided below. **Failure to comply with these rules may result in disqualification or incorrect scoring.**

## Packaging
- The submission must be uploaded as a single ZIP file.
- The ZIP file must contain the corresponding scale folder (x4) with the generated SR images.

```
submission.zip/
├── x4/
│   ├── HR_00.h5
│   ├── HR_01.h5
│   ├── HR_02.h5
│   ├──  ...
```
Make sure there is only one key in the .h5 file, it does not matter what the name of that key is.
The dataset must be a 3D array shaped like: (H, W, C) where C = #spectral bands

## Results

- Once uploaded, refresh the page to update the submission status.
- Scoring could take up to 5 minutes.
- For debugging, click on the submission, navigate to Logs tab, and view Scoring Logs > stdout
pages.content_zh:
# 提交格式

参与者必须按照下面提供的说明提交预测结果。**不遵守这些规则可能导致取消资格或评分错误。**

## 打包
- 提交文件必须上传为单个 ZIP 文件。
- ZIP 文件必须包含相应的缩放文件夹 (x4)，其中放置生成的超分辨率图像。

```
submission.zip/
├── x4/
│   ├── HR_00.h5
│   ├── HR_01.h5
│   ├── HR_02.h5
│   ├──  ...
```
确保 .h5 文件中只有一个键，该键的名称无关紧要。
数据集必须是形状为 (H, W, C) 的 3D 数组，其中 C = 光谱波段数量

## 结果

- 上传后，刷新页面以更新提交状态。
- 评分可能需要长达 5 分钟。
- 为了调试，点击提交文件，导航到日志选项卡，查看评分日志 > 标准输出

pages.title: Publication
pages.content:
# Publication
Participants are invited to submit full research papers detailing the methodologies, findings, and contributions developed within the scope of this challenge. Accepted manuscripts will be published in the official proceedings of the CVPR 2026 Workshop.

### Submission Guidelines
Should participants choose to submit a paper, the following protocols must be observed:
* Submission System: All manuscripts must be submitted electronically via the workshop’s OpenReview system (platform subject to confirmation).
* Formatting: Submissions must strictly adhere to the CVPR Author Guidelines, adopting the mandated structure and formatting requirements.
* Page Limits: Papers are limited to eight pages, including all figures and tables. Additional pages containing only cited references are permitted.
* Review Process: All submissions will undergo a double-blind peer review process.
* Important Date: The deadline for paper submission is first week of March (check main page).

### Challenge Report Co-authorship
For each individual evaluation metric, the top-ranked team will be invited to serve as co-authors on the PBVS HISR challenge report. Furthermore, the results and methodologies of the top three teams per metric will be acknowledged and discussed in the final published paper. Winning teams will be contacted directly with further instructions.

**Note:** Top teams should provide a brief description of their proposed solution along with an illustration of the architecture. This information may be included in a potential publication if the submission is accepted. Additionally, the code should be uploaded in github and shared according to the Terms and Conditions.
pages.content_zh:
# 发表
邀请参赛者提交详细的研究论文，阐述在本次竞赛范围内开发的方法、发现和贡献。被接受的稿件将发表在CVPR 2026研讨会的官方论文集中。

### 投稿指南
如参赛者选择投稿论文，必须遵守以下规程：
* 投稿系统：所有稿件必须通过研讨会的OpenReview系统以电子方式提交（平台待确认）。
* 格式要求：投稿必须严格遵循CVPR作者指南，采用规定的结构和格式要求。
* 页数限制：论文限制为八页，包括所有图表和表格。仅含引用文献的附加页面不受限制。
* 审稿流程：所有投稿将经过双盲同行评审。
* 重要日期：论文投稿截止日期为三月第一周（详见主页）。

### 竞赛报告联合作者
对于每个评估指标，排名最高的团队将被邀请作为PBVS HISR竞赛报告的联合作者。此外，每个指标排名前三的团队的结果和方法将在最终发表的论文中得到承认和讨论。获奖团队将收到直接联系和进一步的说明。

**注意：** 排名靠前的团队应提供其所提方案的简要描述以及架构图示。如果投稿被接受，此信息可能被纳入潜在的出版物中。另外，代码应上传至GitHub并根据《条款和条件》进行分享。
